thread:
alice: Observed OOM spike on kvcache-paged pool us-west1-prod. Multiple containers restarted over past 20m; node flaps. Noticed a slow memory creep across the pool.
eng-oncall-bot: [incident] severity=sev2 · INC-2026-128 created · paging / oncall handoff incoming
priya: Jumping in — seeing repeated CUDA errors in pod logs: 'cuCtxSynchronize' followed by cudaMalloc OOM (700). Attaching snippets.
alice: ```
[2026-03-17T15:12:05Z] ERROR allocator.cpp:482 cudaMalloc failed: out of memory (700)
  at kv_paged_alloc (allocator.cpp:482)
  at model_serving.cpp:128
```
josh: Any recent infra/operator changes? This reads like slab/paged fragmentation: alloc fails, evict attempts ramp, then container restart.
priya: No infra rolls. Correlation: increased prefix miss rate -> more ephemeral KV writes; page churn seems high. Slow creep over hours, not a single spike.
maria: Customer impact: CS reporting latency spikes and intermittent 502s for streaming generation on some hosted tenants. Preliminary affected: ~10-15% of pods in us-west1-prod. Notified customers.
alice: Mitigation plan (short): 1) flip aggressive eviction on affected pool (KV_EVICT_THRESHOLD=0.6) 2) sequentially restart worst nodes 3) route heavy seq-length traffic to alternate pool/compact model variant 4) enable compaction on a stubborn node.
josh: I'll prep the eviction flag change. Also recommend temporarily disable paged-attention allocator on high-seq production routes and route to compact variant to avoid repeated large allocations.
priya: Applying eviction now to nodes us-west1-pool-[3,5,7]. Command: `kubectl patch cm kv-config -p '{"data":{"EVICT_THRESHOLD":"0.6"}}'` then rolling apply.
eng-oncall-bot: Config change recorded by alice/priya at 6371234680 · automated policy guard passed.
alice: Restarting pods sequentially (3 at a time) with 2m delay. Monitoring mem slope and slab_fragment_count metric.
maria: CS update sent: "We're mitigating a memory fragmentation issue impacting some inference endpoints; expected improvement within 15-30 minutes."
josh: Early telemetry: restarted pods show reduced mem slope. One node (us-west1-pool-5-node-12) still shows slow drip and repeated small fragmentation increments: `slab_fragment_count:+12/min`.
priya: Enabling on-demand KV compaction on node-12: `kv_compact=1` and triggering light GC. If compaction succeeds we should see page reclaim.
ops: Scale up fallback: adding +2 GPUs to pool us-west1-prod now as a safety net (scale event at 6371234740).
eng-oncall-bot: Scale event recorded: +2 gpus added to us-west1-prod.
josh: After compaction node-12 reports reduced fragmentation and no new OOMs for ~8m. Overall eviction rate normalized. Latency for affected customers trending back to baseline.
maria: Customer follow-up: 2 of 5 customers who reported issues confirmed restoration. Sending another update in 30m.
alice: Post-incident action items (brief): - add kv_fragment_rate metric and alert when >5/min - tune compact-on-evict heuristic (auto-compact when fragmentation crosses threshold) - investigate paged-attn allocator refcount path that may leak under rapid prefix churn - add canary for paged-attn allocator changes.
priya: I'll file RFC and tag eng-runtime + eng-infra; will also surface detailed heap/profile dumps to the runtime team.
